def g77_collect_rows_acc():
    import math
    execution=json.loads(read(str(g77_execution_path_acc)))
    assert execution['status']=='ALL_CELLS_FINISHED'and len(execution['cells'])==8 and all(c['passed']for c in execution['cells'])
    assert [c['id']for c in execution['cells']]==[c['id']for c in g77_cells_acc]
    rows=[]
    for cell,actual in zip(g77_cells_acc,execution['cells']):
        request=json.loads(read(cell['request']['path']));report=json.loads(read(cell['report']))
        assert report['status']=='PASS_FULL_FROZEN_NATURAL_CHRONOLOGY'and report['kind']=='natural-chronology'and report['fullCheckSuccess']is True
        assert report['observer']==cell['observer']==request['observer']
        assert report['requestSha256']==g56_ref_acc(cell['request']['path'])['sha256']==cell['request']['sha256']
        assert report['image']==request['image']==g77_protocol_acc['images'][cell['content']]['path']
        assert report['imageSha256']==g56_ref_acc(report['image'])['sha256']==request['pins'][report['image']]
        assert report['moduleCount']==17 and report['sourceDeclarations']==2954 and report['stepCounts']=={'expand':263032,'check':1975761}
        assert report['exports']==request['exports']==g77_protocol_acc['runtime']['ABIExports']
        assert report['checksExcluded']==0 and report['outputPatches']==0 and report['acceptanceEvidence']is False
        assert report['workerPolicy']==g77_protocol_acc['runtime']['workerPolicy']and report['limits']==g77_protocol_acc['limits']
        assert report['runtime']['versions']['node']=='23.11.0'and report['runtime']['versions']['v8']=='12.9.202.28-node.14'
        assert report['runtime']['execArgv']==g77_protocol_acc['runtime']['execArgv']and Path(report['runtime']['execPath']).resolve()==Path(g43_tools_acc['node']).resolve()
        assert len(request['inputs'])==52 and all(g56_ref_acc(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in request['inputs'].items())
        assert all(p==str(Path(p).resolve())and g56_ref_acc(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in request['pins'].items())
        t=report['telemetry'];assert t['stepCallbacks']==1975761 and t['stepGates']==121 and t['health']is True and t['sampleDrops']==t['gcDrops']==t['spaceDrops']==0
        assert t['sampleCount']<=256 and len(t['spaceNames'])<=32 and t['gcCount']<=4096
        assert len(t['samples'])==t['sampleCount']*t['sampleStride']and len(t['gcEvents'])==t['gcCount']*6
        if cell['observer']=='on':
            assert t['enabled']is True and t['sampleCount']>0
            p=json.loads(read(report['physicalTelemetry']['path']));assert g56_ref_acc(report['physicalTelemetry']['path'])['sha256']==report['physicalTelemetry']['sha256']
            assert p['status']=='PASS'and p['exit']['code']==0 and p['targetPid']==report['pid']and p['overflow']is False and p['readErrors']==0
            assert p['count']==len(p['samples'])and 2<=p['count']<=4096 and p['intervalMs']==200
            assert p['columns']==g77_protocol_acc['physicalSamplerContract']['sampleColumns']
            assert p['samples'][0][0]<=report['phases'][0]['epochStartMs']and p['samples'][-1][0]>=t['timeOrigin']+t['finishedMs']
        else:
            assert t['enabled']is False and t['sampleCount']==t['gcCount']==0 and report['physicalTelemetry']=={'enabled':False}
        guard=actual['guardian'];assert guard['status']=='PASS'and guard['ownedTreeStopped']is True and guard['timeoutMs']==600000
        assert guard['memoryLimitBytes']==8589934592 and guard['rssLimitBytes']==8589934592
        phase=next(p for p in report['phases']if p['phase']=='check')
        row={k:cell[k]for k in ['id','sequence','block','content','observer']};row.update({'request':cell['request'],'report':g56_ref_acc(cell['report']),'image':g56_ref_acc(report['image']),'checkerCpuMs':phase['userCpuMs']+phase['systemCpuMs'],'checkerWallMs':phase['elapsedMs'],'footprintBytes':guard['peakFootprintBytes'],'rssBytes':guard['peakRssBytes'],'heapSamples':t['sampleCount'],'gcEvents':t['gcCount'],'guardianElapsedMs':guard['elapsedMs']})
        assert all(math.isfinite(row[m])and row[m]>0 for m in ['checkerCpuMs','checkerWallMs','footprintBytes','rssBytes'])
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
